browser_checks.result: Treatment page loads. Tests tab shows regimen-required weekly counts/kidney/liver tests and separate conditional/team-agreed checks. Passport tab shows passport/card links and states that cycle records are on paper.
Explicit combination/continuation phase selector. Continuation explains continuous twice-daily tablets in 28-day review cycles, at least four prior combination cycles and team approval.

Missing phase leaves support unresolved. Combination plus oral-only days resolves to oral minimal-low; changing day to docetaxel resolves to low. Distinct context inputs visible; no patient data entered.

pdf_visual_review.scope: Rendered page collages for all seven three-page guides, plus detailed weekly wallet-card, combination consent form, weekly passport record and 28-day treatment journey. Wallet spacing corrected and re-rendered.
pdf_visual_review.result: Reviewed samples legible with no observed clipping/overlap after correction. Automated page boundaries and QR decoding cover all generated PDFs.

limitations: No mobile-device browser emulation in this pass; responsive CSS and regression checks retained
Clinical, oncology-pharmacy and patient/PPI validation remains pending
